title: Saved views
audience: An engineer reviewing the saved views change
message: Save a filtered task list as a named view.

lines.heading: Keep the work in view.
lines.sub: A pull request walkthrough · Saved views
lines.text: This change lets you save a filtered task list as a named view. Here is the complete flow.
The task list starts with five tasks. Open and completed work appear together, with a status beside each task.
Select Open only to hide the completed tasks. The list now shows the three tasks that still need attention.
Select Save view and enter a name. This name identifies the filtered list, so it should describe the work.
Select Save to create the view. Its name appears beside the filter, while the three open tasks stay visible.

lines.heading: One filter. One named view.
lines.sub: Recorded from the bundled example app
lines.text: The result is a named view of the open work. The walkthrough shows the action and its visible result.
